about_the_game:
Arcana: Card Arena

Arcana: Card Arena is a single-player fantasy card game. Your mission is to build a powerful deck and engage in intense strategic duels to defeat your opponent.

Three Types of Cards

The game features three main categories of cards:

  • Spells: Cast powerful effects on the battlefield. They deal damage, generate new cards, summon minions... and much more!

  • Minions: Essential in combat. They can attack, protect your hero, or trigger special effects.

  • Weapons: Some heroes can equip weapons and attack the enemy directly.

Over 350 Unique Cards

Arcana: Card Arena includes over 350 cards, each with its own effects and styles. Cards are divided into:

  • Common cards: Available for all decks.

  • Hero cards: Exclusive to each character.

In addition, some cards feature alternate artwork and special shiny versions for collectors.

Game Modes

The game currently offers several modes to enjoy at your own pace:

  • Skirmish: Face a random enemy using one of your custom decks.

  • Arena: Build a deck from random cards (both common and hero-exclusive). Earn rewards like cards, gold, skins, and more!

  • Story Mode: Discover the stories behind the heroes in a narrative campaign with unique mechanics.

Unlock EVERYTHING by Playing

Arcana: Card Arena includes no microtransactions, lootboxes, or premium shops.
All game content —cards, skins, modes, and rewards— is unlocked through gameplay. No paid packs, no artificial restrictions. Your progress depends on your strategy.
